title: Your LLM Ran Out of Knowledge — Now What?
talk_summary: A risk/security practitioner describes giving LLMs explicit, binary domain rule-sets (heuristics) plus a problem-type classifier and input-standardization step, instead of relying on tool use, to compensate for missing domain training data. The pipeline classifies the input, reformats it into a standard schema, loads a matching rule-set, then sends it to a reasoning model that visibly applies the rules.

takeaways.technique: Binary domain rule-sets as system heuristics
takeaways.what_they_do: Writes rules in a provable 'must/must not' form per problem domain, loaded as a system-level prompt so the model applies them on top of its reasoning rather than vague guidance.
takeaways.evidence_quote: these are written in a fairly binary way you must do must not do they're provable

takeaways.technique: Problem-type classifier before the main call
takeaways.what_they_do: A dedicated LLM prompt matches the user input against a list of problem types, then selects the appropriate rule-set before the reasoning model runs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's trying to figure out what kind of problem do I have and what rules should I apply

takeaways.what_they_do: Reformats every input into one fixed structured format (editable by the user) so the downstream model always receives consistent, complete fields.
takeaways.evidence_quote: standardization really helps these models work most effectively

takeaways.technique: Split rule-sets into separate editable files
takeaways.what_they_do: Keeps domain rules in separate files pulled into a higher-level system prompt to avoid one unwieldy prompt and allow per-domain edits.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the only reason these are split out it's just because it it helps avoid the prompt becoming too unwieldy

takeaways.what_they_do: Requires the model to cite which rule each conclusion uses, and eliminates options that breach a rule, making compliance checkable.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's starting to reference two times leverage greater than 50% control and those are all rules that it was given
